description:
## X Patch 1.12.2-x.1 — unified six-patch source

All six patches can be selected together for X 12.31.0-prod.01 and 12.32.0-prod.01: Fix external post links; Hide Find more; Hide Who to follow; Hide sports scores (experimental); Hide search relevance prompt (experimental); Copy media URL (image/video/GIF and video download action). Existing five beta features are retained. New media URL actions have passed compilation/tests but not actual Android device verification. Image long-press and media viewer overflow entry points remain unsupported.

patches.name: Fix external post links
patches.description: Opens external X post URLs directly in post detail without using the For You tab.

patches.name: Hide Find more
patches.description: Hides Discover more / もっと見つける under posts and top people recommendations in Search.

patches.name: Hide Who to follow
patches.description: Hides Who to follow / recommended-account modules from timelines.

patches.name: Copy media URL
patches.description: Copy direct image/video/GIF URLs from post options or from the video player's download action.

patches.name: Hide sports scores
patches.description: Experimental: hides live sports game pills at the top of X Home, preserving live-stream pills.

patches.name: Hide search relevance prompt
patches.description: Hides the Is this post relevant to your search? Yes/No survey in X Search results.

release_notes: X Patch unifies all six opt-in features for X 12.31/12.32, including sports scores, search relevance prompts and media URL copy. On-device behavior of newer features remains unverified.
